choices.why: No mustard velvet option exists, so the warm cognac leather sofa is the closest match: a rich, golden-brown tone that suits a lively bohemian scheme, sits well on the honey parquet, and its 193 cm length fits the long right wall.
This honey rattan tub chair is exactly the natural, airy boho armchair requested, and its compact size suits the spot near the balcony door.
At 335×239 cm, this is the only rug big enough to sit under both the sofa and the armchair, and its blue and rust pattern echoes the striped awning.
The folk-print cushions bring the most colour and pattern, including mustard, coral, blue and green, spread across the sofa and armchair.
These cobalt glazed ceramic pots tie into the blue rug and the awning, and several of them spread greenery around the bookcase and the corners.
At 140 cm wide and only 43 cm high, this honey-wood shelf fits neatly under the back-wall window, leaving room on top for plants.
The carved whitewashed mango drum table is a handcrafted boho piece that pairs naturally with the rattan chair and the plants.
The perforated shade scatters playful light, and the red pull cord adds a cheerful pop beside the sofa.
The navy and tan geometric throw adds global pattern to the sofa arm and picks up the blues in the rug.

answer.why: Warm cognac, honey rattan and wood play against blue and rust patterns that echo the striped awning, while colourful folk cushions, blue pots and plants make the bright, empty room feel lived-in and cheerful. Note: none of the sofas comes in mustard velvet, so the closest warm option was chosen.
